copy: Created by a core team of aviation-industry experts, PLATOON is the most sophisticated way to fly private. Our unrivalled connections, collective experience and class-leading hospitality elevate jet charter to a whole new level – where premium is paramount and style comes as standard.  Come join us in the stratosphere and become part of the next generation in aviation.

content.headline: Welcome aboard the all-new Pilatus PC-24
copy: Welcome to precision engineering combined with striking aesthetics. Designed to delight, the PC-24 is your personal Swiss Army knife – with wings. We can fly you into the most exclusive and hard-to-reach airports, avoiding the queues and beating the blues.

data.quote: “The PC-24 truly is a unicorn, there is no other aircraft which comes remotely close.”
data.author: Marc, PC-24 Captain

data.headline: Time to put your head in the clouds
copy: Whether it is fine dining at 45,000ft or a business meeting in the sky, think of PLATOON as your wingman. We are here to make your flight not just any flight – but “the flight”. To take care of your journey from A to Z, and everything in-between. Sit back, relax, and leave all the details to us.
